scope: Original board snapshot contract and native prefab restoration, not complete automatic save/resume

implementation.serializer: Explicit typed streaming JSON with official Unity Newtonsoft package; no reflection or enum-name dependence
implementation.snapshot: Only ScrewInfos and OperatorInfos at root; separate capacity and slot count; nullable source reference fields and constructor defaults
implementation.runtime: Existing native prefab pool and entry delays; preserve saved screw row/column layout, recalculate the entire layout only if any coordinate is missing; fixed nut positions and fresh transient gates
implementation.history: FromScrewIndex, ToScrewIndex and actual transferred NutCount; no animation-object retention
implementation.callFrequency: Snapshot work is explicit and allocates proportional to board size; no Update/LateUpdate serialization or disk writes introduced

coverage: Independent authored original-field fixture and all seed-reference round trips
Null slots and reference fields, omitted constructor defaults and visibility defaults
Case-varied duplicate property order and comments
Numeric enums, hidden nut/V, independent mask/object visibility and lock
Malformed JSON, invalid shape, numeric null/overflow and trailing content rejected
Source runtime exclusions and no invented level identifier
Prefab restore after selection and during transfer, delayed initialization, winning move and completed cap
History retained on restore and cleared on fresh replay; snapshots own copied state
Real Play-mode replay regression: standard Button input, cancel preserves selection, delayed rebuild, effect cleanup and repeated modal use
